newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daehan buys 21,200T of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daehan buys 21,200T of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd bought 21,200 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trader Kanematsu, a company official said on Friday.
The official said the purchase was split into three lots:
6,300 tonnes of Western white/soft white, $143.50 a tonne FOB
3,500 tonnes of hard red winter, $153.15 a tonne FOB.
11,400 tonnes of dark nothern spring wheat, $175.65 a tonne FOB.
Shipment was set for August 5-September 5 to the western port of Inchon.
